clustered RAID can significantly reduce the impact of disk failures and that the mapping based on almost-random permutation can be used to achieve this goal.
clustered RAID provides significant performance and reliability gains over the basic RAID scheme, and that these gains can be obtained using fairly small C and G values.
a clustered RAID with mapping based on nearly random permutation can achieve a significantly lower recovery time and better read/write performance than a basic RAID.

the design of a RAID scheme with improved fault tolerance and reduced performance degradation during recovery.
